decisions: Requests can be assigned only to the organisation’s active admins, who already see every request: assigning shares a student’s message with nobody new. Letting editors handle assigned requests would widen access and is left for the founder.
Teams are a fixed list of seven (International office, Admissions, Accommodation, Visas and immigration, Fees and funding, Student life, IT and campus services); universities cannot edit it yet.
The first step is the longest-standing published guide not marked done, then the next upcoming date. Students marking guides done is still not built in the app, so in practice it is the oldest guide.
The app’s existing notifications offer appears once per account before the university space; the browser check answers “Not now”.
